messages:
maria: FYI — saw an invoice-preview mismatch after the reconciliation run (2026-03-22 03:42 UTC). A subset of tenants have negative provisional balances. Screenshot in thread :eyes:.

oliver: Ugh. Which pipeline/shard? any errors in the reconcile job?

jamal: looks like merges from shard-B applied after the claimflow replay. logs show ordering flips. snippet:
```
2026-03-22T03:41:58Z INFO reconcile: apply_merge req_id=ab12 shard=B seq=1245 merge_id=null
2026-03-22T03:42:01Z INFO claimflow: replay req_id=ab12 shard=B seq=1243
2026-03-22T03:42:03Z INFO reconcile: apply_merge req_id=ab12 shard=B seq=1246 merge_id=null
```

sre-bot: [alert] reconciliation-job(reconcile-v3) failed 3 retries for shard=B, error=merge-sequence-violation.

penny: My suspicion: Kinesis partition key leads to out-of-order delivery under retries. Our dedupe key is request_id but retries create new request_id on clients -> duplicates/ordering holes.

kevin: Quick mitigation: pause invoice-preview consumers for shard B and run idempotent backfill merge with deterministic merge_id. Command I ran on staging:
```bash
redwoodctl reconcile backfill --shard=B --from-seq=1240 --to-seq=1250 --merge-idempotent --run-id=rb-20260322-01
```

maria: The console shows invoice-preview totals +120 vs ledger totals for the same window. Likely duplicate merges inflated preview while final ledger got later corrections. We need a single source-of-truth for merges.

jamal: Agreed. Short-term fix: canonicalize merge_id = sha256(client_fingerprint + logical_seq). That survives client retries. Also emit metric merge_out_of_order_count and tag by shard.

oliver: We should gate schema change behind a feature flag. Proposal: feature flag merge_idempotency_v2; rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100% with canary. Update console to show merge_id and a reconciliation diff panel.

penny: I'll run the backfill for B now (run-id rb-20260322-01). Post backfill status here when done. :white_check_mark:

kevin: Also adding an automated reconciliation check to the preview job: fail fast if preview_total != ledger_total for X consecutive windows. That will avoid shipping bad previews.

penny: Backfill started (rb-20260322-01). ETA ~8m.

sre-bot: job rb-20260322-01 started on runner-12.

penny: Backfill completed. run-id rb-20260322-01. Sample validation: preview vs ledger aligned for sample tenants we checked (ids: tenant_42, tenant_99). :party-parrot:

maria: Great — thanks. Next actions: 1) implement deterministic merge_id, 2) feature-flagged rollout, 3) add merge_out_of_order_count metric + console diff card, 4) add preview fail-fast guard. I'll write a short RFC and link it.

oliver: Add me as reviewer for rollout plan. Also let's add an alert runbook for merge-sequence-violation so oncall can respond faster.

jamal: RFC link: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026-03-22-merge-idempotency — PTAL.

maria: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups in the RFC, moving this thread to resolved for the immediate incident. :thumbsup:
